harnesses.name: hermes
harnesses.note: installs from GitHub: can fail when many people start at once

_comment: The 10 harnesses `aidev-lb run --harness` accepts (the Harness Leaderboard's released ones), with a speed label from the harness install time measured in the room dry runs of 21 and 23 Nov 2026 (40 Jobs x 8 trials, install p50): fast 12 to 41 s, medium 58 to 100 s, slow 112 to 171 s.
